character: Group of Ladin villages in South Tyrol's Val Badia (Corvara, Colfosco, La Villa, San Cassiano, Badia and La Val) on the Sella Ronda circuit, known for gentle, well-groomed intermediate cruising. The Gran Risa in La Villa hosts World Cup giant slalom races (reference).
learning: Reference note: widely regarded as beginner- and intermediate-friendly, with ski schools in each village. Confirm beginner areas.
